context: Replacing the hand-rolled dict validation in validate_user_payload with a Pydantic model.
explanation: This swaps ad-hoc dict checks for a declarative Pydantic model: EmailStr gives real, RFC-aware email validation (the old code only checked for an "@" character), Field(min_length=1) enforces the non-empty display name, and the age validator preserves the exact >= 13 rule the old code had. model_validate raises a structured ValidationError with per-field detail, and model_dump() returns the same shape (email, display_name, age) callers already expect, so this is a drop-in replacement with stronger validation and real type safety.
